contentText:
Gaby Del Valle / The Verge :

A look at growing bipartisan opposition to AI data centers in drought-stricken Arizona, where TSMC's chip fabs were welcomed but newer projects face backlash   —  Industry has drained the state's water reserves for decades.  Data centers are the breaking point.﻿  —  AA hulking gray giant rises from the desert.
